description:
Look up a Sanskrit word: its spellings across scripts, the meanings it carries in this corpus, how many verses gloss it, and examples of where it occurs.

Built from the word-by-word breakdowns of some 30 000 verses, so these are the meanings translators actually assigned to the word in these texts — not a lexicon's list of everything it could mean. Use it before translating a term yourself, and whenever the user asks what a word means.

examples.description: Verses to cite as examples. Default 5.

language.description: Preferred language of the translations returned. Not a filter: works that exist only in Russian are returned in Russian, and each result says which language it is actually in. Default: en.

term.description: In IAST (śeṣa, diacritics optional) or Devanāgarī (शेष). A word written in another script is not in this dictionary — the headwords are Sanskrit — but search_texts will still find it in the prose.

name: lookup_sanskrit_term
title: Look up a Sanskrit word
